decisions.statement: The population the run states is the code and the markup the roster's add-ons hold.
Markup held by an add-on publishing no namespace is counted and left unexamined.
A member defined only in a machine-written file reads here as defined nowhere.
The population the run left unexamined is reported beside the population the run examined.

definition: the run judging every inline markup handler an add-on on the roster holds
